effectSurfaceExtensions: Relay startup launches multiple payment, payout, engagement and monitoring loops.
LUMI import initialization writes storage, profile and audit state under LUMI_CONTROL_PLANE.
KAIROS startup may refresh connector permissions under CEX_PORTFOLIO/KAIROS_AUTONOMOUS_TRADE_CONTROL.
Legacy notifier and durable dispatcher overlap; duplicate legacy payout unit definitions reference a missing /root payout implementation.
Systemd retains legacy /root entrypoints while accepted evidence often binds /opt entrypoints.

newMaterialFamilies.reason: Telegram sells and persists a time-bounded guaranteed rate and later consumes it in a monetary order calculation; indicative market information and generic buy flow do not classify this separate paid promise lifecycle.

An enabled 15-minute timer invokes a root autodeploy script that pulls code, runs partial checks, restarts production services and writes deployment state; this autonomous production writer is not monitoring or an interactive operator workflow.
A separate crypto-news Telegram bot and legacy callback handler own subscription, polling and message-delivery lifecycles outside the Exchange customer-engagement evidence.
A Telethon premium-user session edits channel posts and creates a distinct credential, identity and message-mutation trust boundary.

Two enabled public payment-domain Nginx configs wildcard-proxy to 127.0.0.1:8080, but no mapped active systemd service or container was observed. Ownership, reachability, TLS and payment-truth authority are unbound.

classificationDecisionsStillRequired.reason: Offer, FAQ, how-it-works, contacts, reviews and error pages carry material non-KYC, custody, fee and support claims; classify as a family or explicitly bind them as supporting UI.
FastAPI docs/OpenAPI, Filament/Livewire upload/update/storage and UI catch-all routes need explicit family mapping and auth/exposure classification rather than decorator-only omission.

independentReviews.finding: HTTP decorator counts omit generated docs/admin routes and the enabled public :8080 payment edge has no mapped runtime owner.
Autodeploy, editorial news delivery and premium-userbot post-processing are material families outside the current 25; legacy units expand existing effect surfaces.
Paid durable RATE_LOCKS is a separate monetary lifecycle; public trust/legal content also needs an explicit classification decision.

limitations: Static and framework route enumeration proves declaration/generated presence, not reachability, authorization correctness or acceptance.
Dormant/disabled installed units are inventory, not proof that their processes currently execute.
No environment file or secret value was read; missing upstream ownership cannot be resolved from port configuration alone.
The discovery of omissions terminates any honest completeness claim; it does not prove this omission list is final.
nextCanonicalItem: Classify RATE_LOCKS across all six surfaces and verify its quote, fee, expiry, persistence and money-authority boundary read-only.
